camel_example: aliyun cdn DescribeDomainHttpCodeData --region cn-hangzhou --IspNameEn unicom --EndTime '2021-06-29T05:45:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --LocationNameEn beijing --StartTime '2021-06-29T05:30:00Z' --Interval 300
description_en: Queries the total number and proportions of HTTP status codes returned from an accelerated domain name. The data is collected every 5 minutes
description_zh: 调用DescribeDomainHttpCodeData查询加速域名5分钟粒度的HTTP返回码总数和占比数据
kebab_example: aliyun cdn describe-domain-http-code-data --domain-name example.com --start-time 2021-06-29T05:30:00Z --end-time 2021-06-29T05:45:00Z --interval 300 --isp-name-en unicom --location-name-en beijing --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomainHttpCodeData

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain name. You can specify up to 500 domain names in each request. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).

By default, this operation queries the number and proportions of HTTP status codes for all accelerated domain names that belong to your Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh:
加速域名，多个域名用半角逗号（,）分隔，一次最多支持500个域名查询。

默认查询所有加速域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据起始时间点。
日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据结束时间点。
日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The time granularity of the data entries. Unit: seconds.

The time granularity varies with the maximum time range per query. Valid values: 300 (5 minutes), 3600 (1 hour), and 86400 (1 day). For more information, see Usage notes
parameters.help_zh:
指定查询数据的时间粒度，单位：秒。

根据单次查询的最大时间跨度不同，该参数支持300（5分钟）、3600（1小时）和86400（1天）取值，具体请参见使用说明中支持查询的时间粒度
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en: The name of the region. You can call the DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp operation to query regions. If you do not specify this parameter, data in all regions is queried
parameters.help_zh: 运营商英文名，通过DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp接口获得。如不填该参数，则代表默认查询所有运营商
parameters.name: isp_name_en

parameters.help_en: The name of the Internet service provider (ISP). You can call the DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp operation to query ISPs. If you do not specify this parameter, data of all ISPs is queried
parameters.help_zh: 区域英文名，通过DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp接口获得。如不填该参数，则代表默认查询所有区域
parameters.name: location_name_en

EndTime.description_en: The end of the time range during which data was queried

StartTime.description_en: The beginning of the time range during which data was queried
